When it is 11pm on a weekday or 2am on a holiday, if the user is not at home, turn off the lights, lock the windows and the door.
If the user is not at home, enable the alarm and send an SMS notification to the user to notify him of the activation.

coding.rationale: Five evidence units converge on guarding the home via alarms, locks and shutters whenever residents are away; failure means an unprotected home.

responsibility_name: manage visitor gate access remotely

responsibility_name: prevent kitchen fires when unattended

evidence.evidence_text: When the user is not in the kitchen, the fire sensors are activated and the plates are turned off

responsibility_name: keep evening rooms warm

responsibility_name: keep the evening kitchen warm

evidence.evidence_text: When the user enters the kitchen and the time is between 20:00 – 23:00 and the temperature is below 17 degrees, the radiator comes on, the light goes on and the oven goes on.

evidence.evidence_text: When the user enters the kitchen and the time is between 20:00 – 23:00 and the temperature is below 17 degrees, the radiator comes on, the light goes on and the oven goes on.

responsibility_name: Maintain bedroom warmth in the evening

evidence.evidence_text: At 20:00 turn on the heater in the bedroom

responsibility_name: maintain comfortable indoor temperature

evidence.evidence_text: Very strange. Today at 11 o’clock, I started to think that it was a bit cold… it was set to ‘not at home’… programmed to ‘not-home’ during daytime on Thursdays and Fridays.

responsibility_name: send the news of the day during the shower
